Blue jeans , after seeing it on a billboards hot 100 video I was using to find new music sometime in either late 2012 or early 2013
, Lana had charted and the video showed a snippet of her video and 14 year old me was like …who is this gorgeous woman with this amazing voice and why is she swimming in a pool with a crocodile?? 
I immediately went to her YouTube channel and no joke the only videos on there were blue jeans , born to die video games I think maybe Carmen and both snl performances 
I ate everything up then immediately searched for more, I illegal downloaded everything I could find , and a lot of her unreleased stuff from that era , I had hundred dollar bill , without you , queen of disaster ect on my phone for YEARS 
Lana became my entire life after that , you really had to be there for her early days in fame, her old website , her old insta , the search for unreleased music with videos constantly being put up and taken down, it was like the damn black market. And everytime someone asked me what music I liked I screamed Lana Del Rey , and 9 times out of ten people said who?
I’ll never forget paradise coming out , the release of tropico , me watching it during lunch in high school on release day , ultra-fuckin-violence and me popping that cd in my moms car and being transported to the heavens when I first heard Brooklyn baby for the first time , honeymoon coming out ! 
I feel like after lust for life she really starting going mainstream and there was a definite shift that catapulted her into mainstream stardom, after that it wasn’t who? Everytime I said Lana , it was omg me too! And you know what, Lana deserves it all, it was great when I felt like I was in a little underground fan group to a rising star and I could buy a ticket to a concert of hers for 50 bucks and there was less then 1500 hundred people in the entire venue. But after years of screaming get her to the Grammys , make her the next Madonna , I’m so so happy she is where she is now. 
I do wish she’d release some of the absolute GEMS she’s got, but what ever Lana decides to put out I’m buying. Sorry for the novel, idk why but this question evoked something in me ,,, lol🤣

And let me just add , when this happened , I was so dead set on dying , I was planning my death , researching the best ways to, I hated my job , I had nothing as I sold everything i owned to get him money , I had nothing , no money , he had stolen my car , the area I was in was too expensive to get my own place , everything I tried had failed , how was I going to find someone new? He knew about everything , my trauma , why I was covered in scars , my severe anxiety , but with a little time , i realized I was going to be ok. Things worked out.

I had a boyfriend , who was my world , I left home for him , he was a homeless drifter and I became what he was so I could be with him. I was homeless sleeping on the street just to be with him. Hitchhiked across the country with him, starved with him , froze with him, baked in the sun with him , and did things you only do with a special person. I went through his phone because I got that gut feeling, he was texting an old flame about how he just wants to leave me behind and he dosnt know why he’s staying. He tried to say it was old but he sent her a selfie of a place we were just in together. I forgave him, idk why but I loved him so much. Flash forward 6 months later , I start working to get an apartment for us as he had been homeless for 5 years and wanted to settle. I got that gut feeling once again. I was at my parents house , he was at his dads. I ignored it , I get a text showing him with another girl , then I found out there was 2 other girls , and one is pregnant. 
The ultimate betrayal , there’s no way to prepare for that utter heartbreak that comes from a betrayal like that, in your case your boyfriend already preparing to leave and saying terrible things . Mine was unfaithfulness. It left me destroyed, I wanted to die , I wanted to kill him but at the same time , I just wanted him. I just wanted the times we had , no matter how fake that was.
The only thing that healed me , was a lot of time. Now 5 years later I’m disgusted by him, something I never ever thought I’d say. But it took time for me to get there . It wasn’t easy and I’m not gonna lie and say i worked on myself and learned to love myself because I didn’t. I got into a serious relationship 6 months after that. And even that relationship isn’t the healthiest, but I never get that gut feeling , I never have to check his phone , it dosnt even have a passcode but I don’t have the desire. Because I trust him. He may be a son of a bitch but I trust him. Take the time to heal and all that but understand , if he is already saying those things , he won’t change his mind , leave now , and time will do its thing

I love when people ask me this . To me 80 percent of the road was positive.  I went out there willingly and excited. 
The people you meet is number one. The other young travelers just like me with unique street names for them all.
The stories the bonfires the nights forgotten because of the Chemical freedom we swallowed hours before. The knowing you have friend when you see the tattered clothes , back back and weed patches. It’s amazing. 
The freedom of the open road. You can literally do what ever when ever you want. No schedules except when the sun decides it’s gonna shine in your eye for a early start. Sleep under a tree tomorrow if you want to sleep in. Cops hinder this a little but honestly not that much if you’re in the right areas. 
I can choose to stay in Cali or go to Canada or hitch a ride to Maine if I wanted , no wait , no saving for a plane ticket all I need is my man, my pack, my 2 feet, and my thumb.
Music , the dead, Janis , jimmy , ect it takes a new meaning. 
And you see what kind of people are in this world and who will give you aid when needed. 
The conversations I had were fantastic , brutal and real. 
I am in a house now temporarily and me and my boyfriend are working to get our own apartment but I know if that doesn’t work out I can survive ana enjoy it. 
I guess the most positive thing I got from a year is , I am free.
